name: Rot Hulk

abilities.text: When ~ enters, return up to X target Zombie cards from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of opponents you have.

notes: return-from-graveyard takes a numeric count only, so the X (the number of opponents you have) is written as a move of a chosen set from your graveyard: you pick up to that many Zombie cards. That form chooses on resolution instead of targeting on the stack (CR 115.1), which is the one deviation.

issues: return up to X target Zombie cards from your graveyard to the battlefield — expected 'up to X' — you may choose zero or fewer than X targets — scripted move with what.count={count:'opponents'} and no optional flag; chooseFrom() computes n = min(amt, cands.length) and asks with exact:true (src/engine/game.ts chooseFrom), and returns all candidates outright when n >= cands.length — the return is mandatory — CR CR 601.2c / 115.1 — 'up to' lets you choose fewer, including zero

up to X TARGET Zombie cards — expected targets chosen when the trigger goes on the stack; illegal/changed targets checked on resolution — scripted chooseFrom on resolution (documented in notes), so the cards are not targets at all — hexproof-from-graveyard style effects, 'can't be the target', and target-count checks never apply — CR CR 115.1, 603.3d

Zombie cards — expected any card with the Zombie subtype in your graveyard (includes changeling/Kindred noncreature cards, e.g. Nameless Inversion) — scripted filter.types=['Creature'] plus subtypes=['Zombie'] — narrowed to Zombie creature cards only; render confirms 'Zombie creature cards'

return up to X target Zombie cards from your graveyard to the battlefield — expected Up to X TARGET cards, chosen on announcement; controller may choose fewer, including zero — scripted move with what.count={count:'opponents'}, choose:'you'. chooseFrom() (game.ts:1688-1706) uses exact:true and returns ALL candidates outright when n>=cands.length, so it is mandatory 'exactly min(X, available)', not 'up to X', and nothing is targeted (no shroud/hexproof/target-illegality interaction) — CR 115.1, 601.2c

target Zombie cards — expected any Zombie card (a Kindred/Tribal Zombie card qualifies) — scripted filter narrowed to types:['Creature'] + subtypes:['Zombie']; render reads 'Zombie creature cards' — CR 205.3m

covers/notes — expected the targeting + 'up to' deviation flagged as a need — scripted notes mention the targeting deviation only; the loss of 'up to' (optional zero) is not disclosed and there is no openNeeds/ignore entry
